parentDispositions: Retained prior sealed source/evidence by creating a separate cohort
Corrected Codex draft watermark unpacking: installed asyncio source returns (low, high), not (high, low)
Removed draft broad except Exception from control watcher; errors propagate through work with specific OSError/ProtocolFault handling
Added started drain wrapper and two actual pending/buffer samples, not merely a large write or an unscheduled task
Persist third-write sequence/bytes/attempted/unknown before write; journal never claims delivery and any existing record refuses fresh host launch
Control polling runs separately from blocked activity; Stop observation timestamp must precede cancellation outcome
Abort queued local stdin before cleanup but keep abort/control inside the protected cleanup path; process death requires independent witnesses
Transport failure is recorded as actual write-failed or transport-ended and uncertain/cancelled state rather than a forced errno

First development run exposed wait_closed BrokenPipeError after injected client loss. The error is retained separately only with uncertain write, reaped child, both EOFs, closing transport and zero queue; other close errors still reject
Small handshake baseline records actual queue sizes and remains locally drained; third-write witness equals the saved Windows marker
GLM design scope accepted: 8 MiB is plumbing-only, queue counters are not kernel capacity or delivery. Adjacent samples do not establish throughput/duration
Owner-loss evidence states pending at the observation barrier, not an atomic sample at the later external kill; no dead-host outcome is fabricated
GLM focused source review timed out without a final verdict; DeepSeek fallback completed and its findings were independently assessed, not treated as approval

DeepSeek finding1 rejected: transport flow-control pause suspends drain(), not task scheduling. Actual started task + pending state and measured counters passed on the real non-reading peer. Removing those checks would weaken the witness

DeepSeek finding2 scope clarified: abort intentionally discards queued local input before Stop; zero queue afterward is local closure accounting, not a peer-flush or delivery discriminator. Error, pre-abort byte count, child exit, both EOFs and closing transport are all retained

DeepSeek finding3 rejected: await drain_task inside the sampling loop remains inside the outer try, so OSError reaches the write-failed handler. The actual injected transport-loss run recorded write-failed and uncertain-write

DeepSeek finding4 rejected for the measured profile: EOF waits at most cleanup5s, not the entire protocol75s; work reserves three cleanup phases. Near-deadline OS/startup failure remains explicitly unqualified and outer Job is the backstop

DeepSeek finding5 rejected: failed event is set only by fail() after saving fault; watch_control raises ProtocolFault on EOF and work calls watcher.result(). It cannot return normally on the shown EOF branch
